assay: FACS-sorted GFP+ newborn-neuron nuclei from hippocampus (RV-SYN-GTRgp), SmartSeq v4 RNA-seq (S2.5.p1, S4.19.p1)
sample_inclusion: WT-sed n=4, WT-run n=4, F5KO-run n=4, F5KO-sed n=5; 6-week-old males (FIG15, S4.1.p2)
primary_estimand: Paper's DE estimand in this dataset is F5KO vs WT newborn neurons (459 DEGs) regardless of exercise intervention; the paper states the study was underpowered to detect an exercise effect and reports no exercise DEG count (S2.5.p2). The requested exercise estimand (Run vs Sed) is therefore exploratory.
planned_contrasts: F5KO vs WT, pooled over exercise (S2.5.p2, FIG15c; paper: 459 DEGs)
Run vs Sed: not reported by paper (S2.5.p2: underpowered)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.10.1 on gene-level counts (S4.21.p1); GSEA (S4.22.p1)
